title: CanoeAlaska
specs: Scenic 17-mile float on the Chena River with wildlife viewing opportunities including kingfishers, ducks, beavers, and moose

blurb: Guests can rent canoes, kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and bicycles to explore the Chena River and Fairbanks. They offer shuttle-included day floats on the Chena River, including a full-day 17-mile scenic float. Experienced paddlers can arrange multi-day wilderness river trip outfitting with gear, shuttles, and air taxi coordination.
